title: Gray Varsity Knit with Navy Raglan
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair wears a heathered gray cropped V-neck knit with navy raglan sleeves, cream and red stripes, and a large red letter S. Red cuffs peek at the wrists. She wears dark low-rise jeans. Her expression is calm and direct. A plain white backdrop with soft, even light. Palette of heather gray, navy, and crimson. Collegiate and cozy, in the style of a college knitwear catalog.
workingNotes:
- The gray body and red cuffs are the signature colors.
- Keep the cropped length for a streetwear look.
